From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Susan Frey <susan.frey@govhealth.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: On-prem deployment: GSA exhibit (Clause 24) & temporary witnessing request

Hi Susan —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call, I wanted to surface two items the GovHealth procurement/legal team asked us to confirm ahead of the SOW execution:

1) Clause 24 (licensed runtime / custody): GovHealth is asking for a narrow, time-boxed option to witness a snapshot and an operator key handover for the pilot stage. They requested a written protocol and one-week on-site window.

2) Evidence & third-party witnessing: They prefer a notarized witness or third-party forensics vendor to attest to the snapshot extraction and short-term custody of the image.

Attached is the latest Order Form (OrderForm_Draft_v3.pdf) — it does not yet include the proposed exhibit language we talked through. Can Legal (David) and Sales Ops (Marissa) surface any immediate blockers? Kimberly, can you confirm whether we have a standard playbook we can offer for GSA / federal-ish customers, or will we need a bespoke exhibit?

Proposed next steps:
- We provide a one-page exhibit draft for Clause 24 showing: limited witness window (7 days), scoped non-disclosure for onsite personnel, and acceptance criteria for snapshot verification.
- If GovHealth requires notarized witnessing, we accept a certified third-party vendor (customer pays).
- We schedule a 30-min call next week to agree timeline and procurement items (DocuSign link to follow once legal confirms redlines).

Appreciate any redline guidance.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: OrderForm_Draft_v3.pdf (PDF, 215KB)

From: Susan Frey <susan.frey@govhealth.org>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem deployment: GSA exhibit (Clause 24) & temporary witnessing request

Jordan —

Appreciate the note and the Order Form. A few clarifications from our side:

- The witness window needs to be performed by an "authorized witness" on GovHealth letterhead. For Fed-procurement compliance we typically require either: (A) a notarized witness on-site, or (B) an accredited forensics vendor (we can provide preferred vendor list).
- Duration: the window itself is short (2-4 hours), but we ask for a 7-calendar-day availability period to pick a date that works with internal scheduling.
- Chain-of-custody: we need a hash and transfer log for the snapshot plus an attestation that Redwood did not retain copies beyond the handover timeframe.

I've attached our compliance checklist to help model the exhibit. Procurement will need to review any additional indemnity/repurchase language if the operator key or image custody triggers additional licenses.

Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept (B) and sign a simple addendum that specifies: witness vendor approval process, transient custody retention limit (e.g., 48 hours), and an agreed audit window (one business day)?

Thanks,
Susan Frey
Director, IT Procurement
GovHealth Regional Clinic

Attachment: GSA_Compliance_Checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Susan Frey <susan.frey@govhealth.org>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem deployment: GSA exhibit (Clause 24) & temporary witnessing request

Susan —

Thanks for the checklist — that's super helpful and makes the requirements clear. Quick commercial/ops proposal from our side so procurement can move forward without blocking the pilot:

- Redwood accepts option (B): accredited forensics vendor is acceptable. Customer picks from our approved list or proposes an alternate vendor subject to our standard vendor vetting questionnaire.
- Retention cap: Redwood will hold the snapshot/image for a max of 48 hours post-handover for verification and will provide a SHA256 hash and transfer log. After verification, Redwood will securely delete retained copies and share deletion confirmation signed by the witness vendor.
- Audit window: Redwood will provide a one-business-day audit window post-handover for on-site verification; remote verification can be scheduled within the 7-calendar-day availability window.

For the contract exhibit: David, recommended approach is to add an Exhibit H (On‑Prem Witnessing & Snapshot Protocol) with the three bullets above and a short section on vendor approval and accepted formats for transfer logs and hash values.

If that matches GovHealth's needs, Jordan and I will prepare the Exhibit H draft and the DocuSign orderform link next. Can we aim to share the draft by end of day tomorrow?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem deployment: GSA exhibit (Clause 24) & temporary witnessing request

All —

Quick legal positions so we can get the draft Exhibit H into procurement:

1) Vendor witnessing: we are OK with an accredited third-party forensics vendor, provided the contract includes the vendor approval process (customer provides vendor name; Redwood reserves right to vet vendor for conflicts/security posture).

2) Retention & deletion: we can commit to a max 48-hour transient retention window for snapshot verification. The exhibit should require Redwood to provide deletion confirmation signed by the third-party vendor within 72 hours of deletion.

3) Narrow indemnity carveout: we will not accept open-ended indemnity tied to customer-controlled operator keys. Any indemnity exposure should be limited to Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct in the snapshot handling process.

4) Audit scope: limit on-site audit to the specific witness event and verification artifacts (hash, transfer log). No continual access to Redwood systems. Any additional forensic access beyond the event will require a separate SOW and commercial discussion.

I've attached a marked-up redline for Clause 24 and a short Exhibit H template (redlines_MSA_clause24.docx). Jordan — please coordinate logistics with Susan and confirm proposed dates for the 7-day availability window; Marissa, please prepare the DocuSign orderform once we have agreement on Exhibit H language.

David Kim
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
